entries.answer: CloudCDN is a **Git-native image CDN**. You `git push` images to a GitHub repo and they're automatically optimized (WebP + AVIF) and served globally from Cloudflare's 300+ edge locations with sub-100ms latency. No dashboard uploads, no SDKs — your workflow is `git push`.

questions: how is cloudcdn different from cloudinary
how does cloudcdn compare to imgix
entries.answer: CloudCDN uses a **Git-native workflow** — no dashboards, no SDKs, no credit systems. Cloudinary starts at $89/mo on credits; Imgix at $25/mo on bundles. CloudCDN's Pro tier is $29/mo with straightforward bandwidth billing.

Three tiers: **Free** ($0, 10 GB/mo), **Pro** ($29/mo, 100 GB/mo + transform API + custom domains), and **Enterprise** (custom, unlimited + SSO/SAML + 99.99% SLA). Pro overage is $0.05/GB; Free pauses delivery if you exceed.

questions: is cloudcdn free for open source
entries.answer: Yes — the **Free tier is permanently free** with 10 GB/month bandwidth. No credit card, no trial expiration. Ideal for OSS project logos, banners, icons, and docs assets. If you exceed 10 GB, delivery pauses until next month; files stay in Git.

**Pro is $29/mo** ($278/yr — save 20%). Includes 100 GB bandwidth, the Image Transformation API (resize/crop/format on the fly), up to 5 custom domains with auto SSL, basic analytics, and 99.9% SLA with priority email support (24h response). Overage at $0.05/GB.

questions: what file types can i upload
entries.answer: **Upload:** PNG, JPEG, SVG, ICO, WebP. The pipeline auto-generates WebP (q80) and AVIF (q65) variants for every PNG/JPEG. SVG and ICO are served as-is. MP4 is supported for video up to 25 MB.

questions: what is the max file size
entries.answer: **25 MB per file** for CDN delivery. Files over 25 MB stay in the Git repo but aren't served from the edge. For reference, a high-quality 4K PNG is typically 5–15 MB.

Bandwidth = bytes delivered from edge to end users. **Free**: 10 GB/mo (delivery pauses on overage). **Pro**: 100 GB/mo, $0.05/GB overage. **Enterprise**: unlimited. Origin pulls, CI/CD transfers, and Concierge API calls don't count.
followUps: What if I exceed the free tier?

questions: how does the transformation api work
entries.answer: Append URL params to any asset (Pro+): `?w=800&h=600&fit=cover&format=auto&q=80`. Supported: `w/h` (1–8192px), `fit` (cover/contain/fill/inside/outside), `format` (auto/webp/avif/png/jpeg), `q` (1–100), `blur` (1–250), `sharpen` (1–10), `gravity` (center/face/north/south/east/west/...). Limit: 50,000 transforms/month on Pro.

`?format=auto` reads the browser's `Accept` header and serves **AVIF** first (if supported), then **WebP**, then the original. Every visitor gets the smallest file their browser can decode. Pro+ only.

**Pro: 50,000 transforms/month.** **Enterprise: unlimited.** Each unique URL with params counts as one transform; identical URLs are served from cache and don't recount. Max output dimensions are 8192 × 8192.

questions: how do i purge the cache
entries.answer: **Free:** purges happen automatically on deploy. **Pro/Enterprise:** purge specific URLs, surrogate tags, or everything via the Cloudflare dashboard or API. Purge API is rate-limited to 100 calls/day.

Assets are served with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` — browsers and edges cache for one year. To update an asset, change the filename (e.g. `logo-v2.webp`); that's the standard cache-busting approach. The `manifest.json` itself is cached for 5 minutes.

Median TTFB **under 50ms** in NA/EU, **under 100ms globally**. Assets are served with immutable cache headers (1-year max-age), so repeat visits hit the browser cache. Production assets typically see **>95% edge cache hit ratio**.

Clone the repo, drop files into your project folder, commit and push:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:sebastienrousseau/cloudcdn.pro.git
cp my-logo.png cloudcdn.pro/my-project/images/logos/
git add my-project/ && git commit -S -m "add logo"
git push origin main
```
Within **1–2 minutes** your asset is live at `https://cloudcdn.pro/my-project/images/logos/my-logo.webp`.

questions: do i need to sign commits
entries.answer: **Yes.** All pushes to `main` require signed commits (SSH Ed25519 or GPG). This ensures every asset change is cryptographically verified. See `guide-security.md` for SSH key generation and Git signing setup.

entries.answer: **Pro:** up to 5 custom domains with automatic SSL. **Enterprise:** unlimited with wildcard SSL. Add a CNAME pointing to `cloudcdn.pro` and email support@cloudcdn.pro — provisioning takes minutes.

Assets are served over **HTTPS with TLS 1.3**. The origin repo lives on GitHub with branch protection. Cloudflare provides DDoS protection, WAF, and bot mitigation on all plans. Signed commits on `main` are mandatory.
